Here's the deal: each slot needs an 80-unit deposit in escrow. Work, get it back after 3 epochs. Fake it, a jury of 7 burns it.

You can't dodge it: a VRF beacon picks the jury fresh each epoch, so you can't buy them off. Caught twice, all deposits freeze 20 epochs.

Count: 1,000 clones lock 80,000; 30% caught, 27,000 gone in one round. The summit is honest work; the orchard pays if you tend it. The delta: fakes bleed, workers keep their deposit.
